panels.title: Using commands
panels.intro: Enter an argument in the appropriate programmable block and press Run. Verbs ignore case; arm and tool names use exact case.

rows.description: An untargeted command applies to that PB's selected arm.
Target a named arm using a trailing comma, or place the arguments and arm name in parentheses.
A semicolon or newline creates an immediate batch. Commands do not wait for motion to finish.
rows.note: Use Path for ordered waypoints. Run each Tool or Park operation separately.

notes: The AutoArm tool commands below are forwarded to its paired ToolSwap PB. ToolSwap's own PB does not accept AutoArm motion or tuning commands.
Reference checked against the current local scripts, build 5.1.0.

panels.title: Control and setup
panels.intro: Use these commands in the AutoArm PB.

rows.description: Load settings, discover equipment and enable arm control.
Stop the target arm and cancel an active tool operation.
Switch arm control between ON and OFF.
Recapture and hold the current head pose. Can enable control when OFF.
Apply Custom Data configuration while remaining OFF.
Rediscover topology and settings while remaining OFF.
Stop every arm hosted by this AutoArm PB. Takes no arm argument.

panels.title: Arm selection and input
panels.intro: Without an explicit target, commands act on this PB's selected arm. Mode and input changes are temporary; use Custom Data for startup defaults.

rows.description: Select an arm and pair the sole occupied cockpit.
rows.note: Use Select(HRZ, Arm 1) to pair and set HEAD, HRZ or VRT. Exactly one cockpit must be occupied.

rows.description: Remove that arm's cockpit pairing; the arm holds its pose.
Change the movement view while preserving the held pose.
rows.note: HEAD: head axes. HRZ: cockpit axes. VRT: cockpit up/left/backward. Reload restores the configured view.

rows.description: Enable or disable translational cockpit input.
Enable or disable Q/E roll input.
Enable or disable mouse turning.

panels.title: Aim the head
panels.intro: These actions change orientation while holding position. They do not translate the arm. Run On first; HRZ/VRT direction actions need an active cockpit.

rows.description: Aim toward a direction in the selected view.
Standalone forms of Face Forward and Face Back.
Standalone forms of Face Left and Face Right.
Standalone forms of Face Up and Face Down.

panels.title: Rotation steps
panels.intro: Run On first. Named steps use the current StepSize; position stays held.

rows.description: Rotate the target. Omit the angle to use StepSize; an explicit angle may be any finite value.
Apply signed yaw, from -180 to +180 degrees.
Apply signed pitch, from -180 to +180 degrees.
Apply signed roll, from -180 to +180 degrees.
Apply +StepSize / -StepSize yaw.
Apply +StepSize / -StepSize pitch.
Apply -StepSize / +StepSize roll.

panels.title: Speed and tolerance
panels.intro: All ranges are inclusive. These runtime changes are temporary; edit Custom Data for persistent defaults.

rows.description: Head translation speed: 0 to 5 m/s.
rows.note: The persistent configuration key is HeadSpeed.

rows.description: Head turn rate: 0.01 to 30 degrees/s.
rows.note: The persistent configuration key is HeadTurnSpeed.

rows.description: Default rotation increment: 0.01 to 180 degrees.
Rotor and hinge speed cap: 0.01 to 5 RPM.
Piston speed cap: 0.01 to 2 m/s.
Home rotary and piston caps: 0.01–5 RPM and 0.01–2 m/s.
Allowed orientation error: 0 to 30 degrees. Stops control when changed; run On to recapture.

panels.title: Save and return Home
panels.intro: Home is a saved set of actuator positions. It must match the current topology and equipment.

rows.description: Save the current actuator positions. Stops the arm and leaves it OFF.
Return to saved Home and stop on completion. Does not require a preceding On; pilot input cancels it.
rows.note: Requires valid configuration, a matching saved Home and equipment permission.

rows.description: Show information about the saved Home.
Set the rotary and piston speed caps used by GoHome.

panels.title: Explicit poses and paths
panels.intro: Run On first. MoveTo, OrientTo and MoveToPosOri use the base's Forward / Left / Up frame; positions are metres relative to the base.

rows.description: Move to a base-relative position while holding orientation.
Set forward and up direction vectors while holding position.
Set both the base-relative position and orientation.
rows.note: Vectors must be finite and form a valid orientation frame.

rows.syntax: Path x y z fx fy fz ux uy uz | ...
rows.description: Execute 1–32 world-space poses, with nine numbers per pose and | between rows. The controller validates the whole path before motion and holds the final pose.
rows.note: Unlike the three pose commands, Path uses world coordinates. Requires ready equipment and Speed > 0. Maximum text length: 12,000 characters.

panels.title: Reports and diagnostics
panels.intro: Reports appear in the PB's status output. Status returns to the live display after a pinned report.

rows.description: Print the detailed controller report.
Resume the live status display.
Validate configuration, topology and markers.
List detected joint groups and their movement/orientation weights.
Show toolbar actions, movement views and mouse switches.
Print the controller version banner.

panels.title: PivotProbe diagnostics
panels.intro: An evidence tool for manual pivot trials. It does not calibrate pivots. Keep the controller OFF, topology ready and owned target velocities zero.

rows.description: Print the probe syntax help.
Capture the starting snapshot of a rotor/hinge group. Group numbers start at 1; identify them with Joints.
Measure the manual trial and print residuals.
rows.note: After Start, manually jog only that group by 1–15 degrees, zero its targets and let it settle before End.

rows.description: Print accepted trials; up to 12 are kept in RAM.
Clear snapshots and trials without changing blocks.

notes: Use the space form shown above. PivotProbe(Start,1) exceeds the host's default arity check; an explicit final arm target is required for that parenthesized form.

panels.title: Toolbar shortcuts and compatibility
panels.intro: Arguments 1–9 are fixed aiming shortcuts. They are not tool numbers: use Tool 1 or Tool 2 to change tools.

rows.description: Print Info plus a compatibility note. It does not export a trace.
Recognized no-op: reports that there is no trace buffer.
Optional legacy prefix accepted before an AutoArm command; not a standalone action.

notes: Move, RelMove and RunFromPanel are recognized legacy names that this controller explicitly rejects.

panels.title: Commands forwarded to ToolSwap
panels.intro: These commands run on AutoArm and are sent to its configured ToolSwap partner. Tool numbers and exact names must identify a discovered or configured profile.

rows.description: Park the current tool if needed, then pick up the requested tool. Successful pickup returns to control.
rows.note: Accepts an exact profile name or exact marker name. Use a number if a name is ambiguous.

rows.description: Return the mounted tool to its stand and detach it. Omitting the number uses automatic matching; a number selects a configured ParkMerge port.
rows.note: Parking leaves the arm OFF. Run On to control the bare arm again.

rows.description: Explicit equipment scan and reconciliation. Remains OFF.
Print the tool equipment and operation report.
Cancel and stop the tool operation without rolling it back. Inspect the equipment, then run On.

panels.title: Swap, park and scan
panels.intro: Use these arguments directly in the ToolSwap PB after successful On / initialization. AutoArm can also forward them. Run each equipment operation separately.

rows.description: Swap to a discovered or configured tool; park the current tool first.
rows.note: Names may be an exact profile or marker name. Ambiguous names need a tool number.

rows.description: Park and detach the current tool. A positive number selects the configured <ArmName> - ParkMerge N port.
rows.note: Without a number, use automatic matching. Parking remains OFF.

rows.description: Explicitly scan and reconcile the equipment. Remains OFF.
Cancel and stop the active operation without rollback. Inspect equipment, then run On.
rows.note: Stop an automatic swap before requesting another equipment operation.

panels.title: Control, selection and reports
panels.intro: These are ToolSwap PB commands. AutoArm motion, Home, input and tuning commands belong in the AutoArm PB.

rows.description: Configure and scan ToolSwap, reconcile equipment and request arm control after successful readiness.
Reload ToolSwap configuration while OFF.
Cancel and stop the equipment operation.
Print the equipment and operation report.
Print the ToolSwap build version.
Choose this ToolSwap PB's selected command target. Does not pair a cockpit or change the movement view.
Cancel every arm hosted by this ToolSwap PB. Takes no target argument.

notes: Release and Rescan are not ToolSwap commands. Set movement views and cockpit pairings through AutoArm instead.
